errors.evidence: Machine-generated description misreports Nickel imports as 24.7% (2021) and 25.1% (2022) when they should be 25.1% (2021) and 24.7% (2022) respectively.
The description does not specifically mention the purpose of comparing Russian imports of selected industrial raw materials.
